## Objective

A Claude Code user working with AGDF can install an optional companion plugin from the AGDF marketplace. In the Claude desktop app it shows a side panel with an animated figure and a compact status for the run worked on in that session, updated after each turn. The AGDF core plugin and other hosts stay unaffected, and users who do not install the companion notice no change.
